properties.DailyDataQuery:
SELECT m.[CLIENT_CODE] AS [ClientBillingNo]
	,REPLACE(c.[CLIENT_NAME], '"', ' ') AS [ClientName]
	,CASE
		WHEN c.[close_date] IS NOT NULL THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'CLOSE' THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'CLSG' THEN 'Closing'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'OPEN' THEN 'Open'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'INTAK' THEN 'Intake'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'PRO' THEN 'Prospective'
		ELSE 'Open' END AS [ClientStatusId]
	,m.[MATTER_CODE] AS [MatterBillingNo]
	,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.[MATTER_NAME], CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), ' '), '"', ''), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') AS [MatterName]
	,CASE 
		WHEN m.[close_date] IS NOT NULL THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'CLOSE' THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'CLSG' THEN 'Closing'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'OPEN' THEN 'Open'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'INTAK' THEN 'Intake'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'PRO' THEN 'Prospective'
		ELSE 'Open' END AS [MatterStatus]
	,CAST(m.[OPEN_DATE] AS DATE) AS [OpenedOn]
	,CAST(m.[close_date] AS DATE) AS [ClosedOn]
	,CASE WHEN p.[MATT_TYPE_DESC] = '' THEN 'Undefined' ELSE p.[MATT_TYPE_DESC] END AS [Practice]
	,ISNULL(u.email, '') AS [ResponsibleAttorney]
FROM [dbo].[hbm_matter] m
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[HBL_MATT_TYPE] p ON m.[matt_Type_code] = p.[MATT_TYPE_CODE]
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[hbl_dept] d ON m.[DEPT] = d.[DEPT_CODE]
	JOIN [dbo].[hbm_persnl] u ON m.[bill_empl_uno] = u.[empl_uno]
	JOIN [dbo].[hbm_client] c ON c.[CLIENT_CODE] = m.[CLIENT_CODE]
WHERE m.[STATUS_CODE] IS NOT NULL 
  AND c.[STATUS_CODE] IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        c.[LAST_MODIFIED] >= DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE())
        OR m.[LAST_MODIFIED] >= DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE())
      )
properties.FullDataQuery:
SELECT m.[CLIENT_CODE] AS [ClientBillingNo]
	,REPLACE(c.[CLIENT_NAME], '"', ' ') AS [ClientName]
	,CASE
		WHEN c.[close_date] IS NOT NULL THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'CLOSE' THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'CLSG' THEN 'Closing'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'OPEN' THEN 'Open'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'INTAK' THEN 'Intake'
		WHEN c.[status_code] = 'PRO' THEN 'Prospective'
		ELSE 'Open' END AS [ClientStatusId]
	,m.[MATTER_CODE] AS [MatterBillingNo]
	,REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.[MATTER_NAME], CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), ' '), '"', ''), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ') AS [MatterName]
	,CASE 
		WHEN m.[close_date] IS NOT NULL THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'CLOSE' THEN 'Closed'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'CLSG' THEN 'Closing'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'OPEN' THEN 'Open'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'INTAK' THEN 'Intake'
		WHEN m.[status_code] = 'PRO' THEN 'Prospective'
		ELSE 'Open' END AS [MatterStatus]
	,CAST(m.[OPEN_DATE] AS DATE) AS [OpenedOn]
	,CAST(m.[close_date] AS DATE) AS [ClosedOn]
	,CASE WHEN p.[MATT_TYPE_DESC] = '' THEN 'Undefined' ELSE p.[MATT_TYPE_DESC] END AS [Practice]
	,ISNULL(u.email, '') AS [ResponsibleAttorney]
FROM [dbo].[hbm_matter] m
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[HBL_MATT_TYPE] p ON m.[matt_Type_code] = p.[MATT_TYPE_CODE]
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[hbl_dept] d ON m.[DEPT] = d.[DEPT_CODE]
	JOIN [dbo].[hbm_persnl] u ON m.[bill_empl_uno] = u.[empl_uno]
	JOIN [dbo].[hbm_client] c ON c.[CLIENT_CODE] = m.[CLIENT_CODE]
WHERE m.[STATUS_CODE] IS NOT NULL 
  AND c.[STATUS_CODE] IS NOT NULL
